{{Short description|Computer file encryption software}}
'''CryptoBuddy''' is a simple [[software]] application for the [[encryption]] and [[data compression|compression]] of computer files to make them safe and secure.<ref>{{cite news |title=Research Triangle Software Releases CryptoBuddy 2.0; New Features Added While Speed and Simplicity Remain. |url=http://www.accessmylibrary.com/coms2/summary_0286-23732640_ITM |work=[[Business Wire]] |date=2003-07-08 |accessdate=20 February 2009 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |date=August 2005  |title=CryptoStick USB 2.0 |journal=[[Maximum PC]] |page=86 |issn=1522-4279 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qwIAAAAAMBAJ&dq=CryptoBuddy&pg=PA86 |publisher=[[Future US]] |accessdate=2009-02-20 }}</ref>

==Overview==
The application uses a 64-bit [[block cipher]] algorithm for encryption and a proprietary compression algorithm. The CryptoBuddy software is also used as part of the CryptoStick encryption device from Research Triangle Software, Inc. 

==Release==
The software was released for public use on June 12, 2002.<ref>{{cite news |title=Cary, N.C., Firm Launches New Software with Fanfare of High-Tech Heyday. |url=http://www.accessmylibrary.com/coms2/summary_0286-6848763_ITM |work=[[Knight Ridder]] |date=2002-06-13 |accessdate=20 February 2009 }}</ref>
